title: Extend the knowledge space without rewriting history
steps: Capture source snapshots and explicit evidence class/applicability.
Add or revise curated records and route keywords; add meaningful routing/contract regression examples.
Build a new immutable release, validate references/topology/selectors and check source drift.
Advance current.json only after local checks; keep old releases and external Work state unchanged.
limitation: A reusable execution recipe; historical success does not certify a different source or current native environment.
